title: [Subcontracting] Bug 638816: Preserve Transfer WIP Item flag when toggling off Direct Transfer without a transit route
summary: Fixed a bug where toggling off Direct Transfer on a Subcontracting Transfer Order with a WIP item and no transfer route caused an error. The Transfer WIP Item flag is now properly preserved during the toggle operation.
key_points: The Transfer WIP Item flag was being reset when Direct Transfer was toggled off and no transfer route existed
The fix restores the Transfer WIP Item field alongside other Subcontracting fields during the copy operation
Previously added guard logic now correctly skips redundant re-validation in all toggle scenarios
Added test case covering the scenario without a transit route
Existing toggle tests continue to pass
